phase: operational schema, domain predicates and authenticated read adapters

schema_verification.scope: Server-export field/type presence. SQL row security, triggers, foreign keys and concurrency are NOT verified.

local_domain_tests.scope: Domain predicates only; no DB/concurrency/provider proof

identity_adapter.status: syntax checked; authenticated runtime/isolation proofs pending

limitations: Table-definition parity does not implement SQL RLS, FK/CHECK constraints, partial indexes, append-only triggers or least-privilege roles.
The domain functions are internal predicates, not transactional command services or authorization grants.
Booking, controlled state mutations, dispatch assignment, payment/webhook processing, durable workers and provider integrations are incomplete.
No DB concurrency, rollback, cross-tenant or end-to-end HTTP proof is claimed.
Production identity/rates and live provider activation remain unavailable.
next: Transactional order intake + idempotency + immutable evidence + task/outbox
POD, signed payment evidence and manual refunds
Tenant-isolation, replay, rollback and concurrency proofs before promotion
